title: Face posts no approach rapid: the first motion after the tool call is a 3-axis feed from the tool-change position to cutting depth
body:
A Face operation's posted program has no approach rapid. The first motion after the tool call is a **3-axis feed from wherever the tool change left the spindle, straight to cutting depth**. Every other mill op opens with a `G00` to its start point on the clearance plane.

**Reproduction** (main b57f8d52, `camcraft-cli mcp`):

```
set_stock      {"box":{"dx":40,"dy":30,"dz":10}}
add_tool       {"catalog":"EM-0600-4FL"}
add_operation  {"kind":"face","tool":"EM-0600-4FL","name":"F1","params":{"cut_z":{"offset":-0.5,"reference":"top_of_stock"}}}
generate {}    -> ok
verify {}      -> gate ok, 0 findings
post           {"output":"...","post":"Fanuc"}
```

```
T02 M6
G43 H02
S9500 M3
M8
G01 X-23 Y-12 Z9.5 F300      <- first motion: XYZ together, at plunge feed, from the tool-change position
G01 X23 Y-12 Z9.5 F1200
...
G00 X23 Y12 Z35
```

Haas, Siemens 840D, Heidenhain and Mazak post the same first line. The committed goldens show it in every dialect: `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/face_square_40x40.nc` line 5, `G01 X-5 Y5 Z-2 F100`, and the same line in `haas/`, `heidenhain/`, `mazak/`, `sinumerik/`, `tormach/`.

**Neighbour case that works:** every other mill golden's first motion is a rapid to its start: `contour_plate_with_hole.nc` `G00 X37.711 Y-6.306 Z5`, `pocket_zigzag_plate_with_island.nc` `G00 X4.5 Y4.6 Z5`, `drill_plate.nc` `G00 X10 Y10 Z0`, `slot_wide_channel_rows.nc` `G00 X-10 Y-7 Z5`. The other Face golden, `face_square_40x40_stepped.nc`, has the same gap (`G01 X-5 Y5 Z2 F100`).

**Root cause (confirmed):** the facer's path begins at its plunge point. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/face.rs` starts its builder at `PathBuilder::new(Point3::new(entry, ys[0], p.clearance_z))`, so the path's first move is the Plunge (`face_square_40x40.cl`: `START -5000 5000 5000`, then `Plunge -5000 5000 -2000`). The posts write moves, not the path's start point, so the move to the start is never posted. The other mill kernels start at `(0, 0, clearance)`, as noted in `docs/decisions/632-facing-approach.md`, and open with a Rapid to their start. #632 fixed the same gap for lathe facing.

**Why it matters:**
- The machine does a slow diagonal feed from the tool-change position down to the cut, which is not the program that was verified. Verify judged a vertical plunge from `START` on the clearance plane. The posted line ends at cutting depth from an XY and Z the verifier never saw.
- At F300 from a tool-change height several hundred mm up, the approach takes minutes.

Done means: a Face op's posted program reaches its first plunge via a rapid to the start point on the clearance plane in every mill dialect, pinned by the face goldens and a test asserting the first motion after the tool call is a rapid.

Labels per AGENTS.md for an agent-filed issue: `bug`, `P1`, `area:2d`, `source:agent` (this account cannot set labels).
